description: Archive decode cases for both cores. A case has `file` (path under fixtures/), `content` (inline text), `contentBase64` (bytes) or `generate` ({fileBytes: n} = n spaces; {locations, boxes} = a synthetic valid archive). `expect` is either {summary, needsBackup} or {error: {kind, path}}; path is null when the error has no field (syntax, size, version). Paths hold keys and indexes only. unknownExpiry counts boxes in the cabinet (not removed, not deleted) without an expiry.

cases.name: empty cabinet with only the default location
two locations and no box still needs a backup
one box in a default-only cabinet needs a backup
keys after the first two may come in any order
a UTF-8 byte order mark is skipped
any whitespace between tokens is accepted
